checkScope: 136 editorial records and their v0.2 draft descriptions and questions
caveat: This catches exact-pattern authoring risks; zero matches cannot prove conversational quality or psychological validity.

riskRules.explanation: Unnatural combined-day scenario that artificially combines two activities
Asks how to phrase a question rather than inviting a concrete answer
Axis-polarity phrasing may be vacuous despite distinct proper names
Enumerates axis codes without integrating an everyday scene

additionalManualRisks: Even unique names and phrases can be interchangeable templates
A-axis change and D-axis exploration may overlap, and B1 bipolarity has not been validated
Any P0 same-type story may still be perceived as a compatibility assessment
P1 four-axis difference must not be used to infer poor fit or guaranteed complementarity
Individual circumstances, financial constraints, disabilities and social norms require review
Specific relationship contexts are outside R1 general-purpose scope
